_note: The one global table of npc/behaviour.gd (docs/design_route_npc_behavior.md §2). A row: from (self, or post:<kind> = a free Marker3D post_<kind>_* in an object type), when (gates that must all hold; taken:<kind> = the same object has someone at a post of that kind), do (go = walk to a random spot on pavement; leave = walk out of the scene; play = play here; use = walk to the post and play there), clips (picked at random by weight: only clips a viewer could not tell a reason apart for), plays [min, max] (times the clip plays before the action is done; go and leave are done on arrival), base (the number), tags (multiplied by the person's coefficients in behaviour-people.json; 0 takes the row out). Distance: score x half / (half + metres to the target), nothing beyond sight. jitter: when a person has nothing to do, up to this much is added to each candidate and the highest is picked; the action keeps its jitter. While it runs, the best candidate replaces it only if its score (no jitter) is higher than the action's score with its jitter. rethink: seconds between comparisons (and at once when an action is done). again: seconds a person leaves a row alone after finishing it (not a falling number: finished is finished).
